method: pypdf 7.2.0 opened every page of each PDF. A page is empty when its text layer extracts to nothing. A page is counted as present in the stored extract only when an 8-word window from that page occurs in the stored text. Character totals are the full text layers, not samples. This is not a pixel OCR of image-only pages and it is not training approval.
